WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(month FROM DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)))::INTEGER AS month_number,
        ABS(SUM(op.payment_value))::NUMERIC AS total_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op
        ON op.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY
        EXTRACT(month FROM DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)))::INTEGER
)
SELECT
    ms.month_number,
    ms.total_sales
FROM monthly_sales ms
ORDER BY
    ms.month_number;
